title: Diluting DNA with TE Using .csv File
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Upload CSV file
steps.instruction: Upload the CSV file containing sample information; the file must include a header row and must not contain commas in the header. The "Name" column is omitted for proprietary reasons.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Specify the DNA aspiration rate (default 1; e.g., 0.5 for half speed, 1.2 for 20 % faster), choose whether to track tips (start at A1 of both tip racks or continue from previous run), and select the mount (left or right) for the P20 and P300 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Prepare TE solution
steps.instruction: Place a 50 mL Falcon tube containing TE on the deck, ensuring the TE volume does not exceed 20 mL to avoid pipette plunging.

steps.title: Load TE into plate
steps.instruction: Using a single P20 tip, dispense the appropriate TE volume into each well of a 96‑well plate (up to 96 samples).

steps.title: Load DNA samples
steps.instruction: For each DNA sample (up to 96), pick up a fresh tip, aspirate the DNA volume indicated in the CSV file at the set aspiration rate, and dispense into the corresponding well.

steps.title: Mix DNA and TE
steps.instruction: Aspirate and dispense the combined DNA‑TE mixture to achieve 80 % of the total well volume, repeating this mixing cycle three times for each well.

steps.title: Check TE volume limit
steps.instruction: If any well receives more than 180 µL of TE (exceeding the well volume), the protocol will raise an error and stop.
